goal: Finish PR #259 on its unchanged runtime: one supplemental fixture then three new live missions. Stop Starship feature additions at that boundary.

reused_preflights.conditions: All runtime source/backend hashes match; independent verifier rerun on preserved full record and host captures; original evidence tree content hashes unchanged.
All runtime source/backend hashes match; independent verifier rerun on preserved full record and host captures; original evidence tree content hashes unchanged.

supplement_preflight.requires: New explicit approval of the exact completion-plan hash. The interrupted v2 attempt remains failed and is not overwritten.

live.requires: Successful independent reuse of both completed preflights plus passed new sensor preflight, then separate explicit approval of the exact completion-plan hash.
live.provider_policy: Original Jev plus explicitly delegated DeepSeek; no persistent DeepSeek call-count cap.
live.fault_success: passed physical verification AND ai_control_completed true; a checked fallback is recorded separately, not counted as completed AI control.

failure_policy: Stop on first invalid, interrupted, unsuccessful or live fault without completed AI control. Preserve it and every not-started case. No retry, model resend, threshold/source change or substitute flight under this registration.
no_new_features: new fault kinds or initial states
ci_policy: CI billing restriction is reported separately. No billing change, automatic CI retry, merge or publication is authorized by this registration.
